text:
Include copy of NE’s diagram for how AIIAD relates to the broader scientific process with special emphasis on the part(s) that are related to this module.






Caution Learning Objectives






After working through this lesson, you will be able to:

Explain how Generative AI relates to AI in general
Discuss how learning with and using AI affects skill acquisition and retention
Evaluate the limitations of using AI for inference

Explain what AI does with data
Explore how ecologists/environmental researchers are interacting with AI
Contrast the pros and cons of different model types for research

title: Methods, Analysis, and Interpretation of Results
text:
Include copy of NE’s diagram for how AIIAD relates to the broader scientific process with special emphasis on the part(s) that are related to this module.






Caution Learning Objectives






After working through this lesson, you will be able to:

Explain the ways in which AI can intersect with core data science principles
Practice using AI to review quality and troubleshoot errors from user-generated code
Explain how to code with an AI assistant using a “plan, generate, evaluate, revise” loop
Create a multi-step data analysis workflow using agentic tools
